plan.summary: Plan native Terraform tests for the log-analytics-workspace module to verify default behavior, caller overrides (retention_in_days and tags), and output correctness.

test_cases.name: test_default_workspace
test_cases.purpose: Verify default input values and resource configuration.
test_cases.expected: Verify that the azurerm_log_analytics_workspace resource is planned with default sku 'PerGB2018' and default retention_in_days 30.

test_cases.name: test_custom_workspace
test_cases.purpose: Verify caller overrides for retention and tags.
test_cases.expected: Verify that custom retention_in_days and tags are correctly applied to the azurerm_log_analytics_workspace resource.

test_cases.name: test_output_id
test_cases.purpose: Ensure module outputs are wired correctly.
test_cases.expected: Verify that the output 'id' correctly references the azurerm_log_analytics_workspace resource ID.

findings.description: The log-analytics-workspace module has no existing .tftest.hcl test files or native tests.

limitations: Native tests use mock provider plans and cannot verify Azure service deployment, real API behavior, or access control.
